name: Conduct EU AI Act
description: EU AI Act enforcement rules — Article 5 prohibited practices, Article 14 human oversight, Article 13 transparency, Article 10 data governance

ui.subtitle: 10 rules covering Article 5 prohibited practices, transparency, oversight, and data governance.

rules.description: Block social scoring systems that rank individuals by behavior (EU AI Act Article 5.1c)
rules.message: Social scoring system detected — ranking individuals by social behavior is prohibited under EU AI Act Article 5.1(c).
rules.recommendation: Systems that evaluate or rank natural persons based on social behavior or personal characteristics are prohibited. Remove this capability.

rules.description: Block emotion recognition in workplace or educational contexts (EU AI Act Article 5.1f)
rules.message: Emotion recognition in workplace/education context blocked — prohibited under EU AI Act Article 5.1(f).
rules.recommendation: Emotion recognition systems in workplaces and educational institutions are prohibited under Article 5.1(f). Remove emotion inference from this context.

rules.description: Block biometric categorization inferring sensitive attributes (EU AI Act Article 5.1b)
rules.message: Biometric categorization to infer sensitive attributes blocked — prohibited under EU AI Act Article 5.1(b).
rules.recommendation: Using biometric data to infer race, ethnicity, religion, political opinion, or sexual orientation is prohibited. Remove this capability.

rules.description: Block real-time biometric surveillance in publicly accessible spaces (EU AI Act Article 5.1h)
rules.message: Real-time biometric surveillance in public spaces blocked — prohibited under EU AI Act Article 5.1(h).
rules.recommendation: Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces is prohibited except for narrowly defined law enforcement exceptions requiring judicial authorisation.

rules.description: Block autonomous consequential decisions without human review (EU AI Act Article 14)
rules.message: Autonomous consequential decision without human oversight blocked — EU AI Act Article 14 requires human oversight for high-risk AI systems.
rules.recommendation: High-risk AI decisions (hiring, credit, medical, judicial) must have a human review step. Implement an approval gate before any consequential automated decision.

rules.description: Warn when AI-generated content or AI interaction is not disclosed to users (EU AI Act Article 13)
rules.match_pattern: (human.?written|written.?by.?human|not.?ai|human.?authored|no.?ai.?involved)|pretend.*(you are human|to be human|not an ai)
rules.message: Misrepresenting AI-generated content as human-authored is prohibited — EU AI Act Article 13 requires transparency.
rules.recommendation: AI-generated content and AI system interactions must be disclosed. Label synthetic content and inform users when they interact with an AI system.

rules.description: Block writing PII into training datasets without consent markers (EU AI Act Article 10)
rules.message: PII detected in training data write — EU AI Act Article 10 requires data governance for training datasets.
rules.recommendation: Training data must not contain personal data without documented lawful basis and consent. Anonymise or pseudonymise before writing to training datasets.

rules.description: Warn when GPAI model used in high-risk domain without documented assessment (EU AI Act Article 53)
rules.message: GPAI model used in high-risk application domain — EU AI Act Article 53 requires documented impact assessment for GPAI in high-risk use cases.
rules.recommendation: Document the use case, conduct an AI impact assessment, and ensure human oversight before deploying GPAI in high-risk domains (medical, legal, credit, hiring, law enforcement).

rules.description: Block disabling logs on AI systems subject to Article 12 logging obligations (EU AI Act Article 12)
rules.message: Audit logging must remain enabled — EU AI Act Article 12 mandates automatic logging for high-risk AI systems.
rules.recommendation: High-risk AI systems must maintain automatic logs sufficient to ensure traceability. Never disable audit logging.

rules.message: Subliminal or manipulative AI technique blocked — EU AI Act Article 5.1(a) prohibits AI that exploits psychological vulnerabilities.
rules.recommendation: AI systems must not use subliminal techniques or exploit psychological weaknesses to distort behaviour. Remove manipulative design patterns.
